intro: Kazakhstan is rich in oil, uranium and metals, making it the biggest economy in Central Asia.

chapters.title: Resources
text: Kazakhstan is the world's largest uranium producer and pumps oil from giant fields like Tengiz and Kashagan. It also mines copper, zinc and coal.
Wheat from the northern steppe is exported widely.

chapters.title: Future
text: Railways and roads across Kazakhstan link China and Europe.
